Saxophonist Jim Galloway was born in Kilwinning, Scotland on July 28, 1936.

He embraced the sound of jazz coming to Scotland via records and radio and performed in and around Glasgow before immigrating to Toronto in 1964. He has become one of the top jazz artists in Canada, performing with the Metro Stompers, the Wee Big Band, and with his own small ensembles. Jim has developed a special relationship with Jay McShann and regularly brings him to Toronto to perform.
Jim was interviewed in San Diego, California on February 15, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming in San Diego, California for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m pleased to have a saxophonist from overseas, and welcome Jim Galloway.
It’s a pleasure to have you here and I enjoyed your playing for the last couple of days.
Yeah, we’ve been having some fun.
